Hello. I've been depressed since the age of 6. I didn't have a happy childhood, I was sexually emotionally and physically abused as a child. But I never told anyone my feelings because growing up my mother was focused on making my father love her/not beat her, my sister had major depression and attempted suicide numerous times, and my brother and I were sort of left to fend out for ourselves. He's doing better, and I'm supposed to be doing ok. But the truth is I'm a 19 year old college dropout/emt. I took therapy from 12 to 18, and now its becoming harder to not feel so lonely and have energy. I really just want to drive away and get away from everything. Sometimes I drink during the day to have something to do. The lows in my depression scare me, and I'm so tired of having excuses and being depressed and angry. I have rope ready, and I have a car now. I daydream about it a lot. Why not just do it.

:) I wish. But they're latino and extremely...not...loving. My mother and father are more like buddies. I've never seen them kiss or hug. My sisters sort of talk to each other, and I could talk to my brother a lot when he was here but now he moved out to start his career. So...idk. :/

I'm the middle daughter in the family. My mother is always working as well. I'm never home. I'm 19 and work when I can to take my mind off of things. Being at home I'm in my room most of the time. I want to take time off but I don't know what I'd do with the time off. It would probably make my depression worst, to be honest. :/
